caveat: District figures share each municipality's result by where its single-family homes are (2020 census blocks). They are not forecasts for any neighbourhood or lot.
method: Each city, village and town's result is split across the districts it touches in proportion to its single-family homes in each one. Homes are placed with the 2020 census blocks: each block's 2020 housing units × its block group's share of single-family homes (ACS 2020–2024). 55 areas are split across districts (Milwaukee across 14, Madison across 9); 1,842 lie in one district. Senate districts are the sum of their three Assembly districts. Boundaries: the 2024 legislative districts (2023 Wisconsin Act 94), Legislative Technology Services Bureau.
boundaries: Wisconsin State Assembly (99) and Senate (33) districts, 2024 plan (2023 Wisconsin Act 94), Legislative Technology Services Bureau
